ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Defender Exclusions Added - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modifications to the Windows Defender configuration settings using PowerShell to add exclusions Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-ExclusionPath\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-ExclusionExtension\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-ExclusionProcess\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-ExclusionIpAddress\\ .*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Add\\-MpPreference\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-MpPreference\\ .*")))
